# HTML Links

#### Course: Learn HTML

## HTML Links

We use the <a> tag to create a link. For example,

```html
1<a href="https://programiz.pro">Programiz PRO website</a>
```

Browser Output

![A webpage showing HTML Link.](data:image/png;base64,)

The above code creates a link labeled Programiz PRO website.

When a user clicks on this link, the user is directed to this webpage at https://programiz.pro.

The destination link is provided inside the href attribute, which stands for hypertext reference.

![A webpage showing the Programiz PRO website.](data:image/png;base64,)
